title: Psalm 65: You Crown the Year with Your Bounty
summary: Praise waits for God in Zion, the God who hears prayer and atones for sin. He is the hope of the whole earth, who formed the mountains and stilled the seas and the nations. The psalm ends with a vivid picture of God watering the land and crowning the year with a harvest so rich that the hills and valleys seem to sing.

from.where: The Study Bible's notes on Psalm 65
from.text: After a long run of laments and trust psalms (51 to 64), it opens a group of four songs of praise (65 to 68) that celebrate God's rule over creation and the nations.

line: Praise waits for God in Zion, who hears prayer and atones for sin, stills the seas and the nations, and crowns the year with a harvest so rich the hills seem to sing.
guide: Notice the order: forgiveness, then creation, then harvest. The God who makes the wheat grow is the God who deals with our sin. Next time you eat bread, remember verse 11, and thank the giver of rain, soil, seed and sun.

stanzas.title: Praise waits in Zion for the God who hears prayer
Sins forgiven and the joy of God's courts
The hope of all the earth, who stills seas and nations
God waters and enriches the land
The year crowned with bounty, and the hills sing

verses.t: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song. Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.
O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.
When iniquities prevail against me, You atone for our transgressions.
Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.
You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.
Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.
You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.
You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.
You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.
The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.
The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.
